result.topic_en: Riemann argues that the free choice of the functions for K_ν and of the systems of coefficients should be made so that the derivatives obey more laws. Equating the h-derivative and the x-derivative of the series Σ K_ν ∂_x^ν z h^ν then yields a relation between K_{ν+1}(ν+1)∂^{ν+1}z and K_ν d∂^ν z/dx.
